input: Research visa requirements for moving to Portugal

gold.taskTitle: Research visa requirements for moving to Portugal
gold.taskDescription: Gather and understand the specific visa requirements needed to relocate to Portugal based on the user's personal situation and goals.

questions.title: What country passport are you traveling on?
questions.description: Citizenship determines which visa pathways are available, such as EU freedom of movement versus third-country national routes.

questions.title: What is your primary reason for moving there?
questions.description: The purpose of the move — work, retirement, remote work, study, family reunification — determines the visa category to research.

questions.title: Do you have a job offer or plan to work remotely?
questions.description: Employment status affects whether to research a work visa, the D8 Digital Nomad Visa, or a passive income visa.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for the move?
questions.description: Knowing when the user wants to relocate shapes how urgently research and applications need to begin.

questions.title: Are you moving alone or with family members?
questions.description: Bringing dependents adds requirements around family reunification and additional documentation for each member.

questions.title: Do you have a specific visa type already in mind?
questions.description: The user may already be considering a specific option such as the D7 Passive Income Visa or the Golden Visa, which focuses the research.

questions.title: What is your expected monthly income or financial situation?
questions.description: Most Portuguese visas require proof of sufficient financial means; knowing the income level helps identify which visa thresholds the user can meet.
